english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a tram in Hong Kong.
Pick this for the streetcar or tram reading; Hong Kong speakers use 輕鐵 for specifically light rail.

examples.english: I take the tram to work in the morning.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 daap3 din6 ce1 faan1 gung1

examples.english: I take the trolley to work every day.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 daap3 din6 ce1 faan1 gung1
